jobs.title: Vellox Software Developer
jobs.description:
Vellox Software Developer

**The Opportunity:**

Are you looking for an opportunity to leverage your Full-Stack Software Developer expertise in a high impact role? Booz Allen is building the next generation of products in cybersecurity. We’re modernizing systems with Artificial Intelligence (AI) and building greenfield capability from the ground up. We’re looking for a Full-Stack Software Developer like you to join the team. You’ll design, build, and deploy new applications and capabilities.  
  
You should thrive in a fast-paced environment. You’ll leverage your technical expertise to own and drive feature development end-to-end. Your definition of done includes fully automated testing and verification in a production environment. You stay curious and constantly search for ways to improve existing processes. No task is beneath you.  
  
You should work independently while collaborating with a team to build complex features and integrations, and learn new languages, technologies, and codebases quickly. You should also have experience deploying and operating distributed systems in cloud environments, leveraging DevSecOps best practices.  
  
Join us as we launch next generation cybersecurity products.  
  
Join us. The world can’t wait.  
  
**You Have:**

* 5+ years of experience building and operating distributed systems in production environments
* 5+ years of experience with object-oriented programming, including Python, Go, C#, or Java
* 5+ years of experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
* 5+ years of experience with data storage, including SQL or NoSQL
* 3+ years of experience with containers, including Kubernetes and Docker
* 3+ years of experience with AWS
* 2+ years of experience with CI/CD, GitOps, and developer workflow automation
* 1+ years of experience with agentic coding tools to design and build production-grade applications and features
* Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
* Bachelor's degree

**Nice If You Have:**

* Experience building new app

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend - AI Native
jobs.description:
**Innovate with purpose**

At BILL, we believe in empowering the businesses that drive our economy. By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don’t stop there: we’re creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters.

Working here means you become part of a vision-driven team that’s ready to tackle challenges and build cutting-edge solutions. We value purpose, drive, and curiosity—and we thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. We're remote-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILLders collaborate to deliver real impact for businesses that need more time in their busy weeks.

BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person’s unique skills and experiences. We’d love to hear from you—you might be just what we’re looking for, whether in this role or another.

Let’s give businesses more time for what matters.

**Make your impact at a leading Fintech Company**

BILL's accounts payable, accounts receivable and accountant products move money for hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses. We are rebuilding the backend behind these products so that every capability is built once, in a clean API, and is available to web, mobile, developer APIs and AI agents on the same day.

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will rebuild core AP and AR services. You will design the domain models and API contracts, migrate behavior out of legacy code, and use AI coding agents as a core part of how you work. This is a hands-on product engineering role in a domain where correctness matters: the code you ship decides whether a payment is approved, scheduled and sent.

*

jobs.description:
**The Opportunity:**  
As an experienced application developer, you know how to create secure, scalable software solutions that transform complex business processes into intuitive user experiences. You understand the importance of designing applications that are reliable, user-friendly, and capable of integrating information across multiple systems while maintaining performance, security, and maintainability. We need a developer like you to help our clients modernize mission-critical workflows and improve operational decision-making.

  

As a Full Stack Application Developer at Booz Allen, you'll lead the design, development, and modernization of a software-driven operational dashboard platform supporting the Air Force client. Working as part of an integrated technical team, you'll develop secure web applications that consolidate information from multiple authoritative systems through APIs, data services, event streams, and approved integration mechanisms.

  

With the support of solution architects, data engineers, financial analysts, and integration engineers, you'll build mission-focused applications from the ground up, implement scalable application features, develop user-centric interfaces, and support ongoing platform enhancements. You'll create executive dashboards, operational workflow views, case-management capabilities, and role-based user experiences that provide client leaders and operators with a comprehensive operational picture.

  

You'll help transform fragmented processes, disconnected systems, and manually generated reports into a modern software platform that delivers actionable information to decision-makers.
